entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, look at those ducks over there![n]They must be a family!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This place seriously feels amazing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's not even that far from Shibuya,[n]but it feels so different here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know, Tokyo is so strange.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There are tons of people and tons of stores,[n]yet there are still duck-filled parks here too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It has everything... but it feels[n]like I can't understand any of it.[n]It's honestly kinda scary.
I know what you mean.[clr 27]
I'm not sure I follow.
That comes down to you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, right. You only just[n]moved here, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's because of how strong you[n]are, [fName]. I'm jealous...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, and that's what scares me.[n]It's nobody's fault but mine.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: When I first got here, I had[n]a super tough time adjusting.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's so crowded, and everyone[n]walks really fast... almost like[n]they're angry or something.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even at school, I was only ever the[n]"foreigner." Nobody really knew me;[n]they just spread rumors.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I thought maybe my looks were the[n]problem. I even considered dyeing my[n]hair black to match everyone else...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But that was when Shiho talked to[n]me. The first thing she said was,[n]"Takamaki-san, your paintings suck."
That was mean of her.
That's hilarious.[clr 27]
Was she right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hahaha, it totally was! Then[n]she told me they were so bad[n]that she just HAD to tell me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I thought she was just making[n]fun of me like everyone else,[n]but that wasn't her intention.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: According to her, they were so bad that[n]she just HAD to tell me. Pretty mean, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She most definitely was not!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I don't think they sucked, at least. I ended[n]up getting a D in art though. I wonder why...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still, that was the first time someone here[n]talked to me without mentioning my looks.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We sorta just grew closer after that...[n]and Shiho's been my best friend ever since.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's not why we're here though!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There's something else I[n]need to talk to you about!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you remember what I told you[n]the last time we came here?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: About that female thief in the[n]anime I used to watch? Well,[n]I thought of something!
Tell me.[clr 27]
I'm afraid to know.
...Who?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle* It's gonna knock your socks off!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle* Make fun of it[n]now while you still can.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You forgot!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm talking about that strong,[n]beautiful thief I used to look up to!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know how the villains in[n]those shows are always going[n]on about world domination?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, even though they get beaten by[n]the heroes every time, they never give up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That means they must have[n]really solid hearts...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And that's why I'm going to[n]try and learn from them!
Good idea.[clr 27]
How exactly?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So I've decided...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: About that...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm gonna star in action movies!
That's not going to work.
You haven't learned anything.
Good luck with that.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But they might cast me as a villain!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks! Your support really helps!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All right, I'm making this my[n]ultimate goal for the future.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know, I've never really thought[n]much about what I wanted to do in[n]life... but now I have an objective!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And that only happened because of[n]talking to you, [fName]! Thanks!
I sense a heightened[n]motivation from Ann...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, if I want to be in action movies,[n]I'll need to work on my actions!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder how many sit-ups I'll have to do...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, Ryuji said he knows a good gym![n]I should ask him for advice!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, and I need to tell Shiho[n]that I have a new goal!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She'll definitely be happy to hear that!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Come on, let's jog to the station!
